body: U+0023# 2026-09-30: phone noon cause corrected; rays Step added to PR 2U+000AU+000AU+002A*Phone noon check (Note10+, Impeller OpenGL ES, full screen, phone layout).** The water-mark fix changed nothing on the phone: noon 18.99 ms, glints off 18.97 ms, midnight 11.8 ms.U+000AU+000AThe per-draw probe found the cause: the **sun rays**. Noon runs 18.9 ms, 13.3 ms with rays off, 13.1 ms at midnight. `_paintRays` draws a 120-segment disc mesh (radius 547.2) with `drawVertices` and `BlendMode.modulate` against a many-stop sweep gradient every frame. Baking the rays into one image at 0.5 px/world unit gave 13.2 ms.U+000AU+000AThe glints remain the Mac's noon cost, so the water-mark Step stays.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Amendment (owner approved):**U+000AU+002D New Step `meadow-baked-rays`, criterion 10.18.U+000AU+002D `MeadowRays` in `lib/features/garden/render/meadow_rays.dart` records two colour-neutral masks once at build and tints an image from them when `sunColour` or `raysGlowAlpha` changes. This keeps the no-vector-after-build rule.U+000A  U+002D Tinted masks against today's rays: at most 3 levels on Skia, 5 on Impeller.U+000AU+002D The rays are held by the stage's `_SceneImages` beside the creature sprites, outside the `MeadowLayers` budget. On devices the landscape fills 40 MB full screen and 22 MB page exactly.U+000AU+002D The Step ships inside PR 2: after the main run finishes, `~/.mitosis/field-notes/impeller/rays-run.zsh` builds it on `mitosis/meadow-impeller` with `--no-push`. Then fast-forward `mitosis/meadow-impeller` to the rays branch and push to update PR 2.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Main run.** Lane 8 (window-buttons-clearance) failed. Its worker wrote the new test, then a receipts G11 pre-edit hook blocked adding the one missing import to that failing test file; the worker did not bypass it. I added `import 'package:field_notes/app/shell/window_chrome.dart';` in `trees/small-fixes`. 23 tests pass and analyze is clean. Pending: set Lane 8 to held with a repaired return in `state.json`, then `--resume`, after the run exits.
